title: MeitY Advisory to Intermediaries and Platforms on AI Models and Synthetic Content (15 March 2024)
summary: MeitY issued this advisory to intermediaries and platforms on 15 March 2024. It replaced an advisory of 1 March 2024 that had asked for explicit government permission before deploying under-tested or unreliable AI models. The revised version dropped the permission requirement and eased the status-report requirement. It asks platforms to label under-tested or unreliable models, warn users about unreliable output (for example through a consent pop-up), make sure their AI tools do not enable unlawful content, bias or threats to electoral integrity, and identify AI-generated or synthetic content with labels, metadata or unique identifiers. It follows a December 2023 advisory on deepfakes. Its legal force has been disputed.
key_obligations: Label under-tested or unreliable AI models before offering them in India
Inform users about possible unreliability of AI output
Identify synthetic content with labels, metadata or unique identifiers
Ensure AI tools do not enable unlawful content under the IT Rules
